text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. What game modes should the system support?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The system must support both Player and Player (PvP) and Player vs Computer (AI) mode

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Do we support moves like Castlinh, promotion?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Should the system allow spectators in a game?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Should the board be configurable at runtime and should there be more that 2 players?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - No, Board should be 8x8 and there should be 2 players.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Should players be allowed to undo/redo moves?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Yes, moves should be tracked, allowing undo/redo functionality

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Will there be multiple games going on simultaneously?
